entries.name: WuXi AppTec Co., Ltd.
entries.reason: The Deputy Secretary of War has determined that WuXi AppTec should be removed from the most recent Section 1260H List that was published in the Federal Register on June 10, 2026, in compliance with the order issued by the U.S. District Court of Columbia on August 7, 2026, granting WuXi AppTec's Motion for Preliminary Injunction, which enjoins the Department from enforcing, implementing, or otherwise giving effect to the Department's designation of WuXi AppTec as a Chinese military company under Section 1260H. The entity delisted from the list of ``Chinese military companies'' is also identified in Mandarin and can be found in this notice's docket on https://www.regulations.gov. Search by the docket ID, DOD-2026-OS- 2410. The Mandarin version of the delisting notice is available for public viewing at the Supporting & Related Material tab. Any correspondence related to the 1260H List must be emailed to [email protected].
